components.description: Audio quality analysis benchmark suite (format, loudness, DC offset, noise floor, spectral, phase, dynamics)
components.name: audio_benchmark

components.description: Composers Desktop Project sound transformation via cdp-wasm (232 typed spectral / granular / waveset effects), under a fail-closed parameter and output contract
components.name: cdp_transform

components.description: Content-addressed provenance: a reproducible cryptographic digest of the source audio, plus a short identifier derived from it
components.name: content_hash

components.description: Audio embedding behind a stable vector contract (input: audio; output: L2-normed float32 vector of declared dim). v0 ships 'melstats-v0' — a dependency-light log-mel band-energy vector (numpy) that stands in for LAION-CLAP/MuQ-MuLan without changing the contract. Swap the model, keep the contract.
components.name: embed

components.description: Cheap deterministic DSP features (spectral centroid, rms, zcr, brightness) via numpy. bpm/key are declared null in v0 (deferred to librosa/essentia or the sononym warm-start). A failed decode FAILS rather than reporting a zeroed measurement; decoded_duration_s records how much audio was actually measured, and `decoder` records how it was read.
components.name: features

components.description: Audio format conversion using FFmpeg (powered by audioconv-cli logic)
components.name: format_conversion

components.description: Pre-render the instant-audition artifacts: a 3s hook clip at the loudest window + a waveform PNG. This is what makes the archive scan sound-first and <50ms — you audition hooks, not full takes.
components.name: hook

components.description: LUFS audio normalization using FFmpeg loudnorm filter
components.name: normalization

components.description: Deterministic probe for the archive: content SHA-256 + container/stream facts + loudness for one audio file. No heavy deps (ffprobe/ffmpeg + stdlib). Measures from a file ffmpeg accepts — the original, or a stdlib-salvaged copy for WAVs whose chunk table ffmpeg refuses — and records which in `decoder`. A probe it cannot measure FAILS; it never writes a null record.
components.name: probe

components.description: Source separation via python-audio-separator (UVR model zoo), selectable by a single `preset` knob. Default `hybrid` = two-stage RoFormer→Demucs: RoFormer-grade vocals + a full drums/bass/other split. Also demucs (4-stem), demucs6 (6-stem), roformer/mdx (2-stem), custom. Heavy component — runs in its own venv, not the light path.
components.name: stem_separation
